title: Fall 2: Deadpoint
synopsis: From the survival hit that tapped into the fear of heights and left two friends stranded at the top of a tower comes a climb that goes higher, gets deadlier, and hits with next-level adrenaline. In FALL 2: DEADPOINT, two friends take on new heights in Thailand, where unpredictable terrain, extreme exposure, and nowhere to hide push survival further than ever before.

synopsis_lang.en: From the survival hit that tapped into the fear of heights and left two friends stranded at the top of a tower comes a climb that goes higher, gets deadlier, and hits with next-level adrenaline. In FALL 2: DEADPOINT, two friends take on new heights in Thailand, where unpredictable terrain, extreme exposure, and nowhere to hide push survival further than ever before.
synopsis_lang.zh_hk:
由全球票房神話《愛你致死不渝》監製， 再續《命懸2000呎》恐懼奇蹟新高峰！
積絲因姐姐在2000呎高空電視塔的喪命意外後傷心不已，為了克服心魔，決心與姐姐生前好友露絲勇闖泰國，挑戰懸空3000呎的極限高空棧道，向姐姐無懼的冒險精神致敬。一場突如其來的山崩，二人被硬生生困於萬丈絕壁之上，半步差池定必粉身碎骨！當環境變幻莫測，幻覺幻聽不停來襲，陷入極致絕望窒息感……觀眾實時經歷手心冒汗，挑戰一場沉浸式嚇破膽的觀影體驗！

director_lang.zh_hk: 米高史派勒、彼得史派勒

cast: Harriet Slater, Arsema Thomas, Tom Brittney
